{{Top}}
[[File:Fefzegg4.jpg|thumb|250px|A Fefze with prominent antennae]]
'''Antennae''' were long, thin sensory appendages on the heads of certain [[Species/Legends|species]], regardless of their [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]]. They were commonly found on [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] species like the [[ji-ant]]s,<ref name="SW9">[[Star Wars (1977) 9|''Star Wars'' (1977) 9]]</ref> the [[Fire wasp/Legends|fire wasps]],<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref> the [[Fefze]],<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> or the [[Riileb (species)|Riilebs]].<ref name="AE art">{{JournalCite|13|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref> They were also common in [[Crustacean/Legends|crustaceans]], with examples including the [[Sauvax]],<ref name="g">{{GamerCite|10|Standoff on Leritor}}</ref> the [[Tarc]],<ref name="AE art 195">{{JournalCite|14|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref> the [[Yobshrimp/Legends|yobshrimps]],<ref name="WoSW">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> and the [[crawlfish]].<ref name="GG2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref>

However, antennae could also be found on species belonging to many other biological classifications, such as the [[Gastropod/Legends|gastropodic]] [[Swamp slug/Legends|swamp slug]],<ref name="WoSW" /> the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Mulissiki]],<ref name="LFC">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> the [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Gesaril (species)|Gesaril]],<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> or the [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Fosh/Legends|Fosh]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Antennapalps/Legends|Antennapalps]] were a type of antennae specific to the mammalian [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosars]].<ref name="uaa">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>
